terms.summary: S1 240% ATK single-dummy magic projection of five targets; 70% damage-taken +10% before damage, two rounds.
S2 10×180% magic; checks pre-action Memory and consumes all 15 stacks before empowered damage.
One-time empowered S2: 10×180%; after damage reduces two adjacent allies cooldowns by 2 and grants 10% source base-max-HP ATK for two target actions.

Starts at 1 Memory; +3 at round start from round 2. Configured full-stack round 1–6 replaces unmodeled incoming allied debuffs. First 15-stack reward grants permanent self HP-to-ATK, cleanses 2 debuffs, and grants a two-action shield. No regrowth after S2 consumption.
Two-action unremovable opening barrier on self and two adjacent allies; incoming-damage threshold and blocking amount not calculated.
Hidden S2-upgrade condition is represented by pre-action Memory>=15, not a separately visible state.

unresolved.summary: No combat logs confirm SkillCategory, granter and settlement order. Selected early-full round is a round-start project approximation; actual incoming debuffs could occur within a round.
Text says max HP before stat changes; HP0 is kept as an independent source unit with formation HP included, without inventing an HP/ATK ratio or applying transient max-HP buffs.

Remote MB has no SubSetSkillMB/SubSkillMB files; damage-after cooldown and ATK ordering follows the skill text. The permanent self ATK status remains after Memory consumption because no removal is specified.
